_doc: C3 chief-command golden-capture manifest (capture_command_c3.php). Oracle = legacy/devsam-core PHP (grand truth). The 12 missing C3 chief commands under hwe/sammo/Command/Nation/: a mix of strategic/외교/인사 NationCommands not in the original P2 set. Each entry pins the SAME fields as manifest.json — ctor scope (all 'nation' → 4-arg buildNationCommandClass + 'nationCommand' seed), lotteryActionName (static::$actionName = getName(), DISTINCT from the 6th seed token rawClassName = getRawClassName(true)), the expected ACTING-general action-log line count (logLines — general_record general_id=<gid> log_type='action' rows; dest-general / dest-nation broadcast lines captured separately, NOT counted), crossGeneral (writes a cross-target general action/PLAIN log), broadcast (pushGlobalActionLog general_id=0 history line). The seed fmt is identical: Util::simpleSerialize(hiddenSeed,'nationCommand',year,month,generalId,rawClassName). NOTE: these are STRATEGIC commands — most carry a per-nation strategic_cmd_limit gate (AvailableStrategicCommand) + a diplomacy-state gate, satisfied as a documented static-input precondition (analogous to P1 mid-band exp/ded; the action's draws/log/deltas stay 100% real PHP).

seed.fmt: Util::simpleSerialize(hiddenSeed, scope, year, month, generalId, rawClassName)
seed.sixthToken: rawClassName (ReflectionClass short name incl che_ prefix)

strategic.note: own occupied dest city (def/wall raised toward max); strategic gate.
AllowDiplomacyStatus([0]) = at active war (state 0); sets every nation general train/atmos to 100 (PLAIN dest line on each). zero-arg.
enemy BattleGroundCity (state 0); def/wall *0.2; dest-nation PLAIN + national-history lines.

strategic.rngDraws: rng->choice per enemy general in dest city (+ re-roll if same city)
strategic.note: enemy dest city (state 0/1); moves each enemy general in that city to a random supplied enemy city.

strategic.rngDraws: pickGeneralFromPool (3 name choices/loop) + nextRangeInt(64,70) + fillRemainSpecAsRandom per created NPC
strategic.note: NotOpeningPart(relYear>=3); creates 3+round(avgGennum/8) NPC generals into the actor's city; mutates game_env npccount + nation gennum.
AllowDiplomacyBetweenStatus([0,1]); diplomacy term +3 + state->1, SetNationFront both sides; dest-nation PLAIN + national-history.
AllowDiplomacyWithTerm(1,12) = declared (state 1) with term>=12; diplomacy term -3; dest-nation PLAIN + national-history.
AllowDiplomacyBetweenStatus([0,1]) + commandType arg (another 전략 cmd != self); writes nation_env / dest nation_env delay KV; dest-nation PLAIN + national-history.

special.note: own non-capital supplied dest city -> neutral (scorched); surlimit==0 + DisallowDiplomacyStatus([0]) (peacetime, state != 0). pushGlobalActionLog broadcast. addExperience(-exp*0.1) deliberately lowers actor exp (may level-cross -> levelCross=true; the harness positions the actor mid-band so the post-state stays in-band).

personnel.rngDraws: rng->nextBool($npcSeizureMessageProb=0.01) iff dest NPCType>=2 (msg only; then rng->choice for the npc message text on a hit)
personnel.note: NotOpeningPart(relYear>=3) + FriendlyDestGeneral; seizes gold/rice from a friendly general into the nation treasury; dest PLAIN action line.
FriendlyDestGeneral; detaches a friendly troop MEMBER (troop != 0 and != self). dest action line. (troop==0 / troop==self are alternate single-line outcomes.)

diplomacy.note: DifferentDestNation + surlimit==0 both nations; gold/rice transfer to another nation. TWO acting lines (broadcast + PLAIN). pushGlobalHistoryLog (history, not globalAction).
